items.title: China provides equipment and technology for DNA testing of Rasuwa flood victims
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 23 The Chinese government has provided the Nepal Academy of Science and Technology (NAST) with equipment, materials and technology required for DNA testing. China has transferred the necessary technology to Nepal for DNA profiling to identify people who died or went missing in the Rasuwa floods. items.title: Bhotekoshi floods prompt ADB to cut Nepal’s growth forecast to 4.1 percent
items.summary: The Asian Development Bank has raised its inflation forecast to 5.3 percent and expects the fiscal deficit to widen as reconstruction spending increases following the devastation.

items.title: Over 800 people remain missing from hydropower projects after Bhotekoshi floods, says energy minister Shrestha
items.summary: Shrestha tells Parliament that search and rescue teams are still looking for workers believed to be trapped in underground structures or swept away by the August 26 disaster.

items.title: For Bhotekoshi flood survivors, the tuin is an ordeal
items.summary: In Nuwakot, locals walk for five to six hours to reach the tuin, an improvised cable crossing, then wait for another four to five hours to cross.
